fusions.name: Ram From Above
fusions.desc: Dives onto the target, dealing 16 blunt damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and stunning it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Dislodged Scree
fusions.desc: Looses 3 stones in a spread, each dealing 6 rock damage, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Ledge Perch
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 12 seconds, and your dodge chance by 10% while it lasts.

fusions.name: Moonlit Footing
fusions.desc: At night, your armour rises by 15%.
